d: Long, curly, platinum white hair cascades over the shoulders with a side-swept fringe. The eyes are a pale, shimmering silver with a gentle, smiling expression on a face of apparent young adult maturity. A slender build is dressed in a white collared shirt, a muted green neckerchief, and olive-green trousers tucked into dark brown lace-up boots with fur trim. Over this is a heavy, oversized dark brown leather coat featuring thick brown fur lining on the collar and hem, paired with a small crossbody bag and a gold pocket watch held in a black-gloved hand.
